title: Impact of cell cracks on performance of PV modules with current cell technologies
mechanism: Correlates EL-measured crack length/count and busbar count with series resistance, shunt resistance and Pmax across full-cell PERC and half-cut TOPCon modules.
adaptation: Severity track should grade by isolated/inactive area and be layout-aware (half-cut, busbar count) rather than by crack length; E1 half-cut cells need their own severity rules.
min_experiment: No training arm: in the severity post-evaluation, compare crack-length vs isolated-area severity grades against any available power data; drop crack-length grading if it does not rank cells.
evidence: R: 230 mini-modules, 2 to 12 busbars; crack length/count not universal power-loss predictors; PERC moderate correlation at 200 W/m2 weakening at 1000 W/m2; TOPCon no meaningful correlation.

alt_notes.adaptation: Severity design: do not score severity from crack length; use isolated / inactive area as the severity driver.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training arm; shapes the severity metric choice.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark scoring rule: do not use crack length or count as the severity target. Score isolated or inactive area per cell instead, and keep crack detection (relF1@2) as a separate safety and progression metric.
alt_notes.min_experiment: None. Design input for the severity track.
